cands.bio: Democratic member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 98 since 2010. Former Prichard City Council member and council president, and a former employee of defense contractor Austal USA. Elected chairman of the Alabama Legislative Black Caucus in 2013. Ran for U.S. House District 2 in 2024.

endorsements.text: Listed as endorsed by The Neighborhood Guy's Candidates Jamboree (Sway voting group by Keith Williams) for the 2026 election.

cands.gaps: We couldn't find where Bracy was born or raised, or when he came to Alabama. We found no stated positions from him on data centers, homestead taxes, land ownership, growth, immigration, guns, abortion, schools or policing. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022, 2024 or 2026. The page lists bills he sponsored only as an empty table, so we can't point to specific bills. We found no documented controversies, foreign ties or notable endorsements beyond the one local voter-group listing.

qual.background: Alabama House member since 2010 (16 years), including seats on Ways and Means General Fund in several sessions. Earlier served on the Prichard City Council, including as council president, and worked for defense contractor Austal USA.
qual.why: Long legislative service plus prior local elected office and a private-sector job. Committee seats and the Black Caucus chairmanship were not counted toward the score.
